invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破0.090（基于当前价格0.0901和ATR 0.0009），或融资费率Z-score转负<0%（多头风险缓解），或日线趋势转牛（价格突破SMA50 0.10）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 0.090 (based on current price 0.0901 and ATR 0.0009), or funding Z-score turns negative <0% (long risk eases), or daily trend turns bullish (price > SMA50 0.10).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破1950（基于ATR 19.0025和支撑），或融资费率Z-score转正>0%（空头风险缓解），或日线趋势转熊（价格跌破SMA50 2041.13）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 1950 (based on ATR 19.0025 and support), or funding Z-score turns positive >0% (short risk eases), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 2041.13).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破80（基于ATR 0.909和支撑），或融资费率Z-score转正>0%（空头风险缓解），或日线趋势转熊（价格跌破SMA50 85.95）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 80 (based on ATR 0.909 and support), or funding Z-score turns positive >0% (short risk eases), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 85.95).
